policy: score.json is not edited and no row is rejudged. Disputed rows are listed with the reviewer's claimed value; reports show results as judged and a sensitivity view excluding these rows. Human review in stage 3 settles them.

harness_deviation.finding: run-az1.mjs passed atTimestamp: queryTime to recall for all 57 queries (inherited from candidate-e). Only 3 inputs carry at_timestamp. local-semantic-search.ts takes the factsValidAtTime path whenever atT is defined and skips the active-only filter (includeSuperseded check is gated on atT === undefined).
harness_deviation.evidence: naia arm: 16 of 57 rows have a superseded fact at rank 1; 22-23 rows lack the active successor fact in ranked results (22 by reviewer, 23 by orchestrator heuristic). Active state itself shows correct supersession chains.
harness_deviation.consequence: naia vs simple-vector (-7.7 pp) and naia vs no-kg-spreading (+7.7 pp) are not interpreted as design differences until a corrected run (az2) removes the deviation.
harness_deviation.discovered_by: Fable post-run review; verified by orchestrator against source and capture
